history.summary: Older (2001) freehold 1,281 sqft 4BR boutique in D15 East Coast at $2.5M / $1,952 psf, ~3% above the URA median ($1,898). The 7.9%/yr appreciation rests on only 4 transactions (unreliable), and the boutique scale plus 950m to Marine Parade MRT keep it Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold D15 East Coast 4BR at a $2.5M quantum is reasonably positioned, and the new Marine Parade MRT (TEL) within ~950m is a real catalyst, but the headline 7.9%/yr appreciation is built on just 4 URA transactions and so cannot be trusted, the listing sits ~3% above median ($1,952 vs $1,898), and it's a 2001 boutique with the limited liquidity/amenities that implies. score_1000 of 450 reflects modest risk-adjusted value. A fair freehold East Coast hold, but nothing in the data pushes it to Buy.
red_flags: Only 4 URA transactions — 7.9% appreciation rate is unreliable
catalysts: Freehold in established D15 East Coast lifestyle belt
$2.5M quantum still within a workable buyer band
